uncited: This family encompasses the algorithmic strategies for navigating volumetric data structures and the spatial metadata used to skip empty or occluded regions during ray casting [13739-traversal-and-data-access.md][17387-empty-space-skipping-via-acceleration-structures.md].
It solves the problem of mapping continuous ray paths to discrete data elements while minimizing memory bandwidth and computation [13739-traversal-and-data-access.md].

It sets itself apart from sibling methods like [GL-NeRF](803-gl-nerf.md) and [Occlusion Clipping with Orthogonal Opacity Map](990-occlusion-clipping-with-orthogonal-opacity-map.md) by focusing on the topology of the data access path and explicit hierarchical culling rather than neural approximation or rasterized proxies [13739-traversal-and-data-access.md][17387-empty-space-skipping-via-acceleration-structures.md].
Mathematically, for a uniform grid, this is often a Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) step.
For irregular grids, it involves explicit boundary intersection tests.
